overview_description.description:
Motorway started in 2017 with a vision to build a better car market for everyone, harnessing the power of technology to deliver an amazing experience.

We help everyone to quickly and easily sell their car for the best price from the comfort of home, using only a phone.

Transparent and straightforward in all that we do, our smart tech matches our customers’ cars with a nationwide network of verified dealers. This enables those dealers to buy vehicles direct from private sellers using our fully-online sales platform, with hundreds of cars successfully sold every day.

Reducing time and effort on all sides, we help everyone get the right deal quickly. It all, just, works.

With over 1m car owners using our site and apps every month, we've grown by over 100% year-on-year and the journey's just begun.

product.name: Used Car Selling Platform
product.description: An online marketplace connecting private car sellers with a network of verified car dealers who bid to buy their vehicles.

product.name: Car Valuation Tool
product.description: A free online tool that provides instant and real-time valuations of used cars based on live market data and Motorway’s own sales statistics.

product.name: Daily Online Dealer Auction
product.description: A daily online auction where verified car dealers compete by bidding on listed used cars to offer the highest purchase price to sellers.

identifier.value: Free Home Collection and Same-Day Payment

product.name: Free Home Collection and Same-Day Payment
product.description: A service that arranges free vehicle collection from the seller’s location and processes payment on the same day the car is picked up.

product.name: Finance Settlement Assistance
product.description: A service that helps sellers with outstanding car finance to obtain settlement figures and complete the sale process.

product.name: ULEZ Compliance Checker
product.description: An online tool that checks if a vehicle meets London’s Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) standards and whether it incurs daily charges.
